 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 20, 2026, 03:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Money held jointly with someone else comes up for review for Virgo this Friday. In many homes, Tulsi Vivah celebrations begin this evening, honouring the sacred marriage of the Tulsi plant with Lord Vishnu in the form of Shaligram, with the main ceremony on Saturday. The festival reminds us that partnership carries shared duties. Today the Moon also joins Shani, retrograde in Pisces, your seventh house of spouse and business partners, with Neptune close by. A joint bank account, a shared business fund or a household account may need a careful look. What Shani Wants Checked 
 Shared accounts often run on trust and habit. Over time, that can create blind spots, such as unclear withdrawals, auto-debits nobody remembers setting up, outdated nominee details, or access given to someone who no longer needs it. Neptune beside Shani can make these issues easy to overlook. Shani pulls them into view. Open the latest statements and go through them together, line by line. Clarity Protects the Relationship 
 Money confusion can damage even strong bonds. Shani in your seventh house asks for transparency on both sides. Agree on who can withdraw, who tracks the balance and how large payments are approved. If a business partner holds the account, a simple monthly review can prevent later disputes. Keep the tone calm. The goal is clarity, not blame. The Joint Money House Is Active 
 Mars, ruler of your eighth house of shared funds, sits in Leo, your twelfth house of expenses, beside Jupiter and Ketu. Jupiter there rules your seventh house of partners. Together, they suggest money from a joint account may have gone out faster than expected, perhaps on travel, gifts, or household upgrades. Review those patterns honestly. Join conversation

 Your Own Planets Help 
 Mercury, your ruling planet, moves direct in Libra, your second house of personal money. Venus, ruler of your second house too, now moves direct in your own sign. Today is Friday, Venus’s day. You can explain your view clearly and kindly. The Sun in Scorpio in your third house supports clear, confident conversation. What to Do Today 
 Review statements for any joint or shared account with your partner. Check auto-debits, nominee details and access to it. Set simple rules for withdrawals and large payments. Set a regular monthly review going forward. Keep discussions calm and focused on clarity. Shani Remedy for Today 
 During the Tulsi Vivah ceremony, offer a piece of sugarcane and a few amla fruits to the Tulsi plant and pray for harmony in partnership. Donate to a programme that helps widows learn to manage household finances.
